result.summary:
Independently re-read lib/letflow/design/req369-platform-dashboard-page.md in full (381 lines) -- did not rely on CODE-DESIGNER's result.summary. Ran all five Step 1b checks against all 8 ACs:

(a) Design element + no TBD/deferral: every AC (1-8) maps to a concrete section per Sec 6's table; grepped the file for TBD/'to be implemented'/'to be determined'/TODO -- zero matches. AC6 (live QA E2E) and AC8 (close-out ISS-0700 statement) are explicitly non-code-design elements by their nature (runtime execution / close-out text respectively) and the doc states this reasoning rather than silently omitting them -- not a deferral, an accurate scope statement.

(b) Function signatures fully specified: Sec 1.1 gives PlatformDashboardPage's full signature (no props, JSX.Element return). Sec 1.3's useQuery is fully typed (hook generic <TenantListResponse, ApiError>, queryKey, queryFn source, return/error types) as a config table, not a live call. Sec 1.7 lists the exact ordered hook calls and their I/O types. OidcCallbackPage's change is a decision table (Sec 3), not a new function, which is the correct shape for an edit to an existing function's single call site.

(c) Error handling shape stated: Sec 1.3 states Error type ApiError explicitly and the isLoading/isError/success three-way derivation (rendererState) with classifyError(error) tagging -- not left implicit.

(d) Cross-module dependencies listed: Sec 8 enumerates every read-only dependency (AuthContext, tokenUtils, tenants.ts, queryKeys.ts, QueryStateBoundary, AppShell -- explicitly noting AppShell is NOT modified, per Open Q4).

(e) No implementation code present -- verified with particular scrutiny per the rework note. The only remaining fenced blocks are: Sec 1.1 (bare function signature, no body), Sec 1.5 (a single static <h1> literal, no expressions/handlers), Sec 1.6 (a static <nav> with 5 fixed-prop <Link> literals, no loop/map/logic), and Sec 2 (router.tsx addition shown as a diff-shaped data/route-table literal with UNCHANGED/NEW markers, no control flow). None contain conditional logic, event handlers, hooks wired to state, or a composed render tree -- Sec 1.7 explicitly states its render-output description is 'not a JSX tree to paste.' Sec 1.3's previous live useQuery({...}) call, Sec 1.4's previous if/return, Sec 1.7's previous full function body, and Sec 3's previous ternary-driven navigate() are all confirmed gone, replaced by declarative tables/prose as the rework claimed. This matches the four sections named in the prior FAIL (1.3, 1.4, 1.7, 3) -- re-verified directly against the current file text, not the summary's claim.

All 8 ACs individually checked against a-e: AC1 (Sec 1.5, 1.2, 1.7), AC2 (Sec 1.3, 1.7), AC3 (Sec 1.4, 4), AC4 (Sec 2), AC5 (Sec 3, 3.1), AC6 (Sec 6 note), AC7 (Sec 5), AC8 (Sec 6 note) -- each has a concrete, unambiguous design element. No check failed. PASS.
